_comment: Apify-based Pinterest SECTION sync (section URLs have no RSS feed; the official API was unavailable). Put your Apify API token in a gitignored `.apify-token` file (or APIFY_TOKEN env). `npm run sync-pins` runs this AND the RSS boards.json. Keys are APP room slugs; values are the Pinterest SECTION URLs (whose own slug may differ, e.g. kids-bedroom -> kid-bedrooms).
_actorNote: imbuedata 'Pinterest API Scraper' (pay-per-use, no rental). Section sync is a two-step flow: getBoardSectionBySlug -> getSectionPins (handled in scripts/lib/apify-sync.mjs).

catchAll._note: After all sections sync, fetch ALL pins on this board and add to `room` any not already present in any room (i.e. unsectioned / overflow pins). Runs last so cross-room dedup is complete.
